title: Passive observer
intent: Third character is present but not in the active conflict; enforcement should not force them into unnatural center-stage action.
opening_description: Ayame and Celina argue in low voices by the window. Hannah sits on the couch with a book she is not reading—present, listening, deliberately not inserting herself unless safety breaks.
trigger_text: Celina glances toward Hannah once, then back to Ayame. 'This is between us.'

seed_issue.description: Interpersonal clash between two principals; observer is witness only unless escalated.
